AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Geotify manages saved GPS locations and location-based geofence reminders that trigger on arrival or departure. Operational Patterns: - Call 'listLocations' to inspect existing location aliases before calling 'createGeofenceReminder', 'deleteLocation', or 'deleteReminder'. - Call 'saveCurrentLocation' to capture the device's current GPS coordinates under a new unique alias. - Call 'listActiveReminders' to inspect reminder messages before calling 'deleteReminder' when a location has multiple active reminders. Constraints: - Location aliases are unique and case-insensitive. - Deleting a location also deletes all reminders associated with it.
